chunks: So the magicians were assembled at a stated time and place on an appointed day.
ai.seo_question: When and where were the magicians assembled to challenge Moses?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Ash-Shu'ara describes the gathering of Pharaoh's magicians for a specific, pre-arranged time and place to compete with Prophet Moses (AS). It highlights the organized nature of the event and the significance attached to the magicians' challenge against the divine messenger. In Shia exegesis, this public spectacle underscores the political dimension of the prophetic mission, where divine truth confronts established earthly power structures through a display of superior authority.
